capabilities: Fetch Yandex Calendar events for the daily note's date
Format events with a template using variables like ${summary} and ${timeStart}
Insert formatted events at the cursor position
Store the Yandex app password in Obsidian's secure storage
Trigger insertion via command palette or hotkey
disambiguation: Not a two-way calendar sync; it only inserts one day's events into a daily note at the cursor.
extras: README is in Russian; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires the core Daily Notes plugin and an internet connection.
problem: Obsidian daily notes have no native way to pull in calendar events, so users must copy schedules manually.
summary: Yandex Calendar integration that fetches the current day's events and inserts them into daily notes at the cursor via a template.
